craft_notes: Sthāyin: resting — sense-rests. Rows: truths then rests. Read aloud: pause points.

lines: That mantra-might, in truths unbroken and unstruck —
in outward-homeward pauses, in ear, in eye, where twin marks meet.
l4.sanskrit_cite: avyucchinnānāhataparamārthair mantravīryaṃ tat gamanāgamaviśrāntiṣu karṇe nayane dvilakṣyasamparke
